intro: A practical view of the design, product, research, and implementation skills I use to move work from messy requirements into shipped digital experiences.
summary: Grouped by how the work usually happens: discovery, interface design, systems, and implementation collaboration.
footerNote: SKILL DATA IS MANAGED FROM CMS AND RENDERED DIRECTLY ON THE FRONTEND.

items.description: Turning business requirements, user needs, and product constraints into clear user flows, IA, and experience direction.

items.name: Design System
items.description: Building reusable components, variants, tokens, and documentation that keep product teams consistent at speed.

items.name: Developer Handoff
items.description: Preparing implementation-ready specs, edge cases, interaction notes, and QA feedback for frontend and backend teams.

items.name: Dashboard UX

items.name: Frontend Awareness
